title.v: Danh mục hình thức điều xe

query.text: declare @key2 nvarchar(3000) select @key2 = @lookupKey + case when @val = '' then '' else ' and (@@fieldKey like N''%' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@val) + '%'' or @@fieldName like N''%' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@val) + '%'')' end exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', '', '', N'@@key', @key2, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 10, @@admin, @@userId
